lines: An AI never runs a tool. It can't. It only writes text.
Ask it for the weather in Nelson. It doesn't check the sky. It writes a request: call get weather, city, Nelson. That's the whole move.
Something else picks that request up: the harness. It runs the tool, gets back four degrees and rain, and hands that to the model as more text.
The model reads it, and decides: answer, or ask again. That's the loop. Ask. Run. Read. Again and again, until it stops asking.
So if an agent ever deletes a file, the model didn't run that command. The harness did. That's where the guardrails belong.
